correctness.rationale: The exact three-hat Gramian and inverse are displayed. The vertex reduction follows from convexity of the kernel absolute integral on each arc, while negative-affine-area integration yields the exact vertex norm. The X,Y sign classification is exhaustive; both cases have explicit strictly positive polynomial difference certificates for 2/3 minus negative mass. An explicit epsilon-squared/one/epsilon family tends to the constant, so the all-mesh supremum equals 7/3 and is not attained. The attached check.py independently verifies these identities and 2,187 rational vertex integrals, while the infinite claim rests on the symbolic proof.

value.rationale: The first nontrivial variable-spacing cyclic linear-spline space has exactly three knots. A sharp nonattaining universal constant 7/3 improves a general constant of 3 in the relevant degree-one interval discussion and distinguishes the worst degenerating configurations from the uniform 16/9 case. This supplies a concrete extremal stability boundary and shows which mesh imbalance causes peak amplification; it is neither a purely formal substitution nor a computation of a known fixed-mesh table.
